description: Reference verdicts for the report-definition package_id dimension (#8971). Each case applies its overrides, replacing whole top-level members, to a fresh copy of the base definition, validates the result against core/reporting-report-definition.json, and grades it with the advisory rule. expected.schema_valid is the schema verdict. expected.violations lists the rules a schema-invalid case breaks. expected.advisories lists advisory findings, which never fail a definition.
rule: At contract_version 1.2, a definition whose dimensions include media_buy_id MUST include package_id. A definition without media_buy_id, whose rows aggregate across media buys, is exempt at every version. 1.2 keeps every 1.1 rule, including restatement_policy.official_correction_mode. A 1.0 or 1.1 definition that includes media_buy_id but not package_id stays valid and is reported as an advisory finding.

violation_codes.package_id_dimension_missing: A contract_version 1.2 definition includes media_buy_id in dimensions but not package_id.

advisory_codes.package_id_dimension_missing: A contract_version 1.0 or 1.1 definition includes media_buy_id in dimensions but not package_id. Rows cannot be split back into packages; publish a 1.2 definition with package_id.

cases.description: The base 1.2 media-buy definition carries package_id.
A 1.2 media-buy definition without package_id fails.
A 1.2 definition whose rows aggregate across media buys has no media_buy_id and is exempt.
A 1.2 account-level total with no dimensions is exempt.
The rule keys on media_buy_id: a 1.2 definition with package_id and no media_buy_id is valid.
1.2 keeps the 1.1 rule that requires official_correction_mode.
A 1.1 media-buy definition without package_id stays valid and draws the advisory. The reporting-reconciliation reference fixture has this shape.
A 1.0 media-buy definition without package_id stays valid and draws the advisory.
A 1.1 definition may already carry package_id; it draws no advisory.
